Title: UmbraDesktop Media Add-on
Description: Fix an image without leaving the backoffice. The Image Editor crops, adjusts, marks up, redacts and resizes images from the media library, and saves them back or as a copy.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the media apps.
Notepad, Paint, Sticky Notes and the rest of the small tools. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.
Games for the desktop. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.

Screenshots.Caption: The Image Editor cropping a photo to 16:9, with rotate and flip beside it and the image's name, folder, size and zoom in the status bar.
